rv.q: It's the loudest show in town and also the smokiest - the boys are never seen without cigarettes dangling from their lips - but it's also the most interesting pop show since Jersey Boys.
I actually found myself rather taken by the thing, even if the docu-drama nature of musicals about great bands feels overdone.
It's a small show wrapped up big for a West End theatre, and there are moments of clunkiness in the handling of the ensemble in the Hamburg scenes.
It’s a beautifully wrought and darkly cynical evocation of an era, and a particular place, as the Beatles found their inimitable voice...
Even ignoring comparisons between the two, Backbeat is an incoherent mess.
It is the stuff in between that is incoherent and unconvincing.
